name: Toast
shortDescription: A notification shown for a few seconds, with an icon, a title and a message (info, success, warning, error).
description: A toast is a small notification that appears for a few seconds without stopping the game: an achievement unlocked, an item found, a game saved, an error...
Use the action "Show a toast" with a title, a message and a kind (info, success, warning or error, which changes the icon).
If a toast is already shown, the new one is shown right after it.
Ready-to-use toasts in many styles are in the asset store [toasts pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=toasts-toasts).
